notes.title: Long-awaited update released!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [u]Added character customization.[/u]
[*] [u]Added shop with clothes that affect the style.[/u]
[*] [u]Now you should unlock genres.[/u]
[*] [u]Added more animations for your rapper.[/u]
[*] [u]Steam Achivements.[/u]
[*] [u]Some fixes[/u]
[/list]

[b]Now you can buy RapStar Tycoon with a discount of 30%![/b]

notes.title: Update announcement!
notes.content:
The first update will be coming soon released.

In this update, we'll add a few features that are not enough in the current version.

Namely:
[list][*] Creating your own character at the beginning of the game.
[*] Character customization.
[*] Shop with clothes that affect the style.
[*] More animations for your rapper.
[*] In-game news.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]
